info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Classes API provides access to a comprehensive list of fitness classes available for members. It allows users to search and retrieve detailed information about various classes, including schedules, instructors, and membership requirements. Ideal for fitness enthusiasts and gym administrators, this API enables seamless integration into fitness applications, enabling users to make informed decisions about their fitness activities. Leverage this API to enhance user engagement by offering diverse class options and schedules.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of membership classes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the different types of membership classes available. It provides important information that users may need to understand their options for memberships and associated benefits.
